name: Cabbage Peas Sabzi
ingredients: 1 tsp mustard seeds and ½ tsp cumin seeds
1 green chilli and 1 tsp ginger, minced
steps: Heat the oil and crackle the mustard and cumin. Add chilli and ginger.
Add the potato and turmeric with 2 tbsp water, cover and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the cabbage, peas and coriander powder and stir-fry on medium-high for 6 minutes.
Add the crumbled tofu and cook for 3 minutes.
Season with salt and finish with lemon juice.
note: A quick dry sabzi; do not add water to the cabbage or it will stew.
